'''Owpa Awoz''' was a captain of the [[Hidden Daggers]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Mori was a skilled pilot, last seen flying a [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]. He wore red and black colored [[Reinforced Insulated Sheath armor|R.I.S. armor]].

When the Hidden Daggers attacked more and more [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and even [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] pilots in the Corellian system in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], CorSec [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Rhea]] ordered one of his pilots to take out their leaders. The pilot destroyed several Hidden Daggers starfighters until the pirates decided to send their best pilots to bring the CorSec pilot down. The first three Hidden Daggers captains to attack were [[Russ Grimblade]], [[Xopw Laow]] and [[Mori]], but they were shot down and killed. Awoz was the last leader of the Hidden Daggers to engage the CorSec pilot. His X-wing was destroyed in the dogfight and he was killed.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateHiddendaggerPilots.jpg|thumb|right|250px|All possible depictions of Owpa Awoz]]
Owpa Awoz appears in one of the duty missions for CorSec pilots in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', available from Sergeant Rhea in [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]]. After killing several waves of pirates, one of the pirate leaders spawns and has to be killed by the player. [[Russ Grimblade]] is the first of these leaders, followed by [[Xopw Laow]], [[Mori]] and Owpa Awoz.
